subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should @agent autocomplete be implemented as part of a shared Control UI composer suggestion contract, and should it reuse `agents.list` rather than add a new `agents.directory` RPC?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent product/API shape affects composer architecture, Gateway method surface, accessibility behavior, and the adjacent custom-term suggestion request.

options.title: Design Shared Suggestions First
options.body: Create a shared suggestion/chip contract for slash commands, @agent mentions, and custom terms, reusing `agents.list` unless a concrete missing field requires an additive API extension.

options.title: Ship @Agent Only
options.body: Implement a narrow @agent-only autocomplete path now, accepting later refactor risk if custom-term suggestions need a different source or composer behavior.

options.title: Defer Rich Mentions
options.body: Keep the current slash-only textarea composer until maintainers prioritize richer WebChat input editing and suggestion semantics together.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Suggestions First
recommendation.body: Create a shared suggestion/chip contract for slash commands, @agent mentions, and custom terms, reusing `agents.list` unless a concrete missing field requires an additive API extension.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main ownership signal across the extracted composer and agent metadata surfaces involved in the product/API choice.
